;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Ten civilians are killed when a suicide bomber detonates his [[Explosive belt|explosive belt]] in a crowd of worshippers at a [[Shia Islam|Shia]] [[mosque]] in eastern [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]]. [https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201906211076007598-blast-kills-shiite-mosque-in-eastern-baghdad/ (Sputnik)]

;Business and economy
*[[Korean Air]] confirms that US carrier [[Delta Air Lines]] has acquired a 4.3% stake in Korean Air's parent company [[Hanjin|Hanjin Kal]], which may help Hanjin resist pressure from an [[activist shareholder]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-delta-stake/white-knight-delta-buys-stake-in-korean-air-parent-dampens-activist-threat-idUSKCN1TL1EO (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Ministry of Transport and Communications (Myanmar)|Ministry of Transport and Communications]] orders mobile phone companies and internet providers to suspend service in nine townships in [[Rakhine State]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190623-internet-blackout-imposed-myanmars-restive-rakhine-state (France 24)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A [[Beechcraft King Air]] [[Parachuting|sky diving]] operation plane crashes near [[Dillingham Airfield]] on [[Oahu]], [[Hawaii]], killing all eleven people onboard. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/jun/22/nine-people-die-in-hawaii-plane-crash (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Japan–Russia relations]]
**[[Ministry of Defense (Japan)|Japan's Defense Ministry]] says [[Russian Air Force]] bombers violated southern Japanese airspace, prompting [[Japan Air Self-Defense Force]] fighters to scramble and escort the planes out of the area. [https://japantoday.com/category/national/russian-bombers-violate-japanese-airspace-prompt-asdf-scramble (''Japan Today'')]
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**Foreign Minister of Saudi Arabia [[Adel Al-Jubeir]] says Iran "has to understand that its aggressive behaviour cannot be sustained" and that his country is "trying to avoid a war at all costs". [https://news.sky.com/story/saudi-arabia-wants-to-avoid-war-with-iran-at-all-costs-11745775 (Sky News)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[June 2019 Iranian shoot-down of American drone]]
**[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] officials say that President [[Donald Trump]] ordered the [[United States Armed Forces]] to conduct [[military strike]]s against targets of the [[Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran]] in retaliation for [[June 2019 Iranian shoot-down of American drone|downing]] an American surveillance [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] the day prior, and that he changed his mind hours later and ordered an immediate stop to the operation while American [[Military aircraft|warplanes]] were in the air and [[warship]]s were in position. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/20/world/middleeast/iran-us-drone.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/president-trump-ordered-military-strike-iran-reversed-sources/story?id=63853570 (ABC News)]
**[[Iranian American|Iranian Americans]] protest outside the [[United States Department of State|State Department]] as tensions increase. [https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/USIran-Tensions-Trigger-Protests-in-DC_Washington-DC-511646082.html (NBC Washington)]
*[[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] spoke to [[Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia|Saudi Crown Prince]] [[Mohammad bin Salman]] about Middle East stability and the oil market, the White House says, after tensions with Iran prompt a rise in oil prices. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-usa-saudi/trump-talks-to-saudi-crown-prince-on-iran-oil-idUSKCN1TM275 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Brecon and Radnorshire recall petition]]
**[[Chris Davies (Conservative politician)|Chris Davies]], Member of the UK Parliament for the Welsh constituency of [[Brecon and Radnorshire (UK Parliament constituency)|Brecon and Radnorshire]], is removed from his position following a successful recall petition in the wake of his conviction for fraudulent expense claims. A [[2019 Brecon and Radnorshire by-election|by-election]] will be held to replace Davies. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-politics-48720176 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*In a school of the [[Moquegua]] city, in [[Peru]], 66 children are poisoned by a leak from a gas regasification plant, located 300 meters away. All affected students were taken to a nearby health center. [https://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/mas-60-escolares-resultaron-intoxicados-fuga-gas-cerca-colegio-moquegua-n376378 (América Televisión)] [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2019/06/21/moquegua-unos-66-ninos-se-intoxican-por-fuga-de-gas-de-planta-regasificadora-fotos-y-video/ (''La República'')]
